invariants.rationale: The method uses tileSet.getProperties() and passes tileSet to addStaticTiledMapTile, so tileSet must not be null.
imageResolver.getImage is invoked in both branches.
The method calls getRelativeFileHandle(tmjFile, ...), so tmjFile must be non-null.
firstgid is used as a base ID for tiles and acts as an offset or starting index; negative IDs are unlikely intended.
tilewidth and tileheight are used for region sizes and increments, and the loops imply they must be positive.
